search.snippet: An air tiara is a head slot item used in Runecraft. It is created at the Air Altar by using a tiara or air talisman on the altar with both in your inventory. This consumes the air talisman and yields 25 Runecraft experience. Using the Air Altar during Guardians of the Rift does not allow for imbuement...
search.title: Air tiara - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: For example, a player who wishes to create an air tiara must enter the Air Altar ruins, and use the tiara on the altar with an air talisman in their inventory. The talisman itself is lost in the process.

search.snippet: Some updates may not be included – see here for how to help out! The Make-X system has been added to crafting tiaras on runecrafting altars. Updated the symbol on the air tiara to be a little more visible. Added to game. An air tiara is made by combining an air talisman with a tiara. Players may create an air tiara here by using either an air talisman or tiara on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 25 Runecraft experience. Air talismans can be obtained as a reward from the Rune Mysteries quest, or as drops from various monsters. The item became permanently available with the launch of RuneScape 2. The item was added to the RuneScape 2 Beta. The air talisman is a talisman that allows players to enter the Air Altar. Air tiaras are created by using a tiara on the air altar with an air talisman in the inventory, which grants 25 Runecrafting experience. The talisman is consumed in the process. Wearing an air tiara lets you enter air rune altars without using an air talisman. Dec 20, 2022 · Testing it with the newly added Nutcracker staff, a fun weapon that always hit 0s. Meaning we can safely aggro any NPC without gaining any combat xp.
